name: Seibo Kyoushi Waga Ko kara no Kyouiku Shidou
original_name: 性母教師　我が子からの狂逝苦指導
source:
Fukasawa Miki is a language teacher at a prep school. Lately she has been building up a lot of tension from work so her only stress reliever for her is to indulge in masturbation. On that day she was alone in the classroom, she started  masturbation, she keep pleasuring herself, making occasionally some noise but was sure no one was watching so it was ok...

However there was in fact someone watching from the shadows, her (adopted) son Fukusawa Yuuta, the door suddenly opens and her sons looks with a cold glance, Miki tries to explain but...
translation:
深泽美纪是一所预科学校的语言老师。最近她因工作而变得非常紧张，所以她唯一的缓解压力的方法就是沉迷于手淫。那天她一个人在教室里，开始手淫，不断地取悦自己，偶尔发出一些声音，但确定没有人在看，所以还好……

然而其实有人在暗处注视着她的（养子）儿子福泽雄太，门突然打开，儿子们冷眼看着，三木试图解释但是……
